title: The Nervous System and Reflexes
summary: Neurons, synapses, the reflex arc and the parts of the human brain.
objectives: I can describe the structure of a neuron.
I can trace a reflex arc.
I can name the main parts of the brain and their jobs.
misconceptions: All actions are controlled by the brain.
Nerve messages are chemical all the way.
Reflexes can be learned in a day.
